functions.name: analyze_skin
functions.title: Analyze skin selfies
functions.description: Runs an AI dermatology analysis on facial selfies and returns detected skin concerns with severity, confidence, and an overall skin assessment. Use when a user asks about their skin condition. Requires a front-facing photo; optional right and left profile photos improve accuracy. Each image must be a data URI starting with data:image/ and under 10MB. Limited to 3 analyses per hour per user.

frontImage.description: Front-facing selfie as a data URI starting with data:image/ (required, max 10MB)

rightImage.description: Right profile selfie as a data URI starting with data:image/ (optional, max 10MB)

leftImage.description: Left profile selfie as a data URI starting with data:image/ (optional, max 10MB)
